repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record, as dev.knotless.getRepo takes it.

runner.description: The account a knotless runner reports as, by handle or DID.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such repository, or no such account.

errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.

errors.name: UpstreamFailure
errors.description: Nothing changed, as the reason says: the account is not the owner.

main.description: Takes an account out of the runners the repository's record names, as `knotless runner remove` does, as the account logged in to this appview's web pages, which must be its owner: its checks of the repository no longer show. A private repository's runner stays a member of it until unshared. Answers with the runners it names after. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets, or an admin's service token.

description: Stops naming an account among a repository's runners, as its owner logged in to this appview's pages.
